title: KP Bundle And Application Isolation

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 26-slice Tranche B proposal with preservation, verification, and stop boundaries.

allowedWork: Bundle scenarios, manifest closure analysis, attribution, budgets, and stable measurement commands.
Typed native-KaTeX pack ownership and behavior-preserving place-value closure repair.
Studio, Public Web, development-review, dashboard, CSS, algebra, Vite helper, and narrow-entrypoint isolation.
Adjacent tests, compatibility retirement, project memory, and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: No SvelteKit adoption, physical package extraction, new animation, curriculum, layout, or visual-design work.
No budget increases used instead of structural repair and no mutation of protected economics authoring files.
No Public Editor, accounts, SRS, learner modeling, or arbitrary plugin architecture.
goal: Make each KP experience load only the capabilities it needs, repair place-value bundle headroom structurally, and isolate Internal Studio and Public Web production graphs without weakening the framework-neutral kernel.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging; preserve user-owned economics files and unrelated documents.
stopConditions: Stop if visible behavior, choreography, semantic identity, URLs, or static output would change.
Stop if an entry graph cannot be isolated without SvelteKit or physical packages.
Stop if place-value cannot reach ten percent headroom without product or visual changes.
Stop if KaTeX migration changes native endpoints, accessibility, or paint ownership.
Stop if splitting duplicates a heavy runtime or increases selected closure.
Stop if Vite helper extraction makes ownership less attributable.
Stop if unrelated user work overlaps a required file.
Stop if release evidence becomes non-deterministic or work must broaden into a deferred tranche.

slices.title: record-approved-proposal-contract-and-baseline
slices.summary: Approved proposal and complete typed contract are durable; inherited bundle baselines, zero-exception ownership, visual preservation, and protected economics files are explicit.

slices.title: audit-current-bundle-tools-and-assumptions
slices.summary: The audit distinguishes static entry, declared activation, runtime request, incremental, common, exclusive, and negative closure; it also records the reproducible 75,026-byte place-value failure and the exact seams the generalized model must replace.

slices.title: define-typed-selected-experience-scenarios
slices.summary: Selected experiences now have one data-only typed declaration for static entry, ordered activations, comparison bases, positive and negative ownership, and per-phase budgets; invalid and ambiguous declarations fail closed.

slices.title: generalize-vite-manifest-closure-model
slices.summary: A pure deterministic Vite-manifest graph now models static entry closure, discoverable but unloaded dynamic roots, ordered activation, owner-attributed script/style/font/asset resources, and exact incremental deltas.

slices.title: declare-representative-experience-scenarios
slices.summary: Declared immutable build and experience registries for catalogue shell, five selected catalogue domains, Internal Studio, and four Public Web lessons.

slices.title: add-stable-scenario-measurement-command
slices.summary: Added a deterministic multi-build scenario measurement CLI, concise baseline, detailed attribution mode, owner gates, and explicit budget checks.

slices.title: audit-native-katex-consumers-and-ownership
slices.summary: Audited native-KaTeX costs and callers; fixed a narrow lazy feature-pack contract, operation-evaluation exemplar, preservation laws, and deferred place-value migration boundary.

slices.title: define-native-katex-feature-pack
slices.summary: Defined the immutable canonical native-KaTeX feature-pack contract, implementation view, literal lazy loader, concurrency coalescing, and retry behavior without changing production callers.

slices.title: migrate-canonical-equation-katex-caller
slices.summary: Migrated canonical operation evaluation through the lazy native-KaTeX pack, preserving settled endpoints, accessibility, reader session identity, visual ownership, and bundle closure.

slices.title: migrate-katex-callers-and-enforce-negative-closure
slices.summary: Routed exact-fraction, log-exponent, and canonical reader consumers through the lazy native KaTeX pack; specialized diagram-slot equation capabilities now derive from typed family declarations; negative non-KaTeX closures and focused runtime evidence pass.

slices.title: attribute-place-value-production-closure
slices.summary: Attributed all 74,948 place-value comparison bytes and both activation phases; compositor plus surface own 73.7%, while data-only catalogue declaration is 136 bytes. Targeted measurement now exposes exact activation and delta files with transitive bases.

slices.title: separate-place-value-semantic-startup
slices.summary: Place-value semantic startup now remains in typed family declarations while one literal selected renderer import owns implementation loading; redundant registration was removed, full closure fell 17 bytes, and behavior stayed unchanged.

slices.title: isolate-heavy-place-value-rendering
slices.summary: Deferred the canonical native-KaTeX renderer until the first written-motion checkpoint, retained deterministic direct seek and disposal, made KaTeX CSS ownership explicit, and reduced selected place-value closure to 51,396/75,000 gzip bytes.

slices.title: prove-place-value-headroom-and-preservation
slices.summary: Proved 31.5% headroom at initial place-value selection and 10.8% headroom for the separately measured native-motion activation; all 126 browser checks pass across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with semantic, responsive, Review, seek, rewind, and lifecycle behavior preserved.

slices.title: declare-application-entry-ownership
slices.summary: Declared one immutable entry-ownership authority that distinguishes present from required boundaries for the neutral kernel, Internal Studio, Public Web, development tooling, and compatibility routing; duplicate and incomplete ownership fails closed.

slices.title: isolate-internal-studio-production-entry
slices.summary: Added a dedicated /studio/ shell, production config, and typed entry that selects only the legacy editor or canonical Svelte catalogue; its independent default-editor closure is 316,521/490,000 gzip bytes and excludes bootstrap, Public Web, and development owners.

slices.title: isolate-public-web-production-entries
slices.summary: Removed three Public Web HTML inputs and two publication compilers from the shared Vite graph; all four lessons retain dedicated builds and explicit ownership, negative closure excludes Studio, bootstrap, and development tooling, 44 Chromium checks pass, and the shared build now transforms 1,413 modules instead of 1,445.

slices.title: narrow-legacy-root-bootstrap
slices.summary: Reduced bootstrap to a typed route selector, lazy capability dispatch, and pagehide ownership; concept publication composition now lives behind a lazy compatibility entry, the initial root closes at 3,860/10,000 gzip bytes, and six canonical legacy routes mount without URL or visible changes.

slices.title: prove-development-tool-production-erasure
slices.summary: Every production config now inspects Rollup rendered-module ownership; development experiment roots, Review implementations, toolbar CSS, capture, and authoring/save code are erased while dedicated builds and compatibility routes pass.

slices.title: make-dashboard-startup-data-only
slices.summary: Dashboard loading now has an explicit cached data-first capability contract: the 14.6 KB gzip data projection settles before the 57.8 KB renderer and showcase closure is requested; measured Studio phases and the existing browser round trip pass.
